decisions.reason: The quantified customer savings are a strong early signal of value, so the option looks worth extending rather than abandoning.
Having its own product page suggests a meaningful commercialization commitment, and after only one year there is still upside to keeping the option open.
Evidence is still thin, but with no clear negative market signal and relatively low holding costs on an established platform, it is premature to abandon it.
The product is only lightly evidenced so far, yet for an experienced German machinery firm the uncertainty has likely not resolved enough after one year to justify withdrawal.
